name: What is the difference between wood framing and metal stud framing for home interiors?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between wood framing and metal stud framing for home interiors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wood framing using standard dimensional lumber remains the preferred choice for most residential remodels, additions, and basement finishes because it easily fastens to subfloors and accepts finish carpentry, trim, and heavy cabinetry. Metal framing consists of lightweight, galvanized steel studs that will not warp, rot, or twist over time. While steel studs offer perfectly straight lines and work well for simple non-load-bearing partition walls, they require specific fasteners and extra wood blocking for mounting heavy items like televisions or floating shelves. Traditional wood framing provides straightforward versatility when hanging solid doors or custom moldings.
acceptedAnswer.description: Wood framing offers solid holding power for cabinets, doors, and trim, while metal studs are lightweight, straight, and fire-resistant but require special fasteners and backing.
